messages.text:
I hear you, Shawn. Thank you for saying it out loud. You don’t have to hold all of it in by yourself right now.  

Do you want me to just sit here with you in it for a bit, or would it help if I helped you untangle some of what’s weighing on you?  

And—just so I know—are you safe in this moment?
